name: bbs
description: Give your coding agent a goal. 2build plans, builds, reviews and verifies, with progress saved on disk.

interface.shortDescription: From a goal to a reviewed, tested change.
interface.longDescription: Autopilot carries one ticket from requirement to a verified local commit in your Codex session. Plans, checkpoints and review/QA evidence stay on disk so work can resume after a restart. Team runs a whole project as an autonomous product team on Orca: you approve the design, then review the handover and give the release go.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use 2build autopilot to build this requirement end to end.
